title: information about steering committee
body:
Add description of steering committee.  Include temporary list of members until we create a separate website.

The committee can decide what other information should actually go here and what to do about possibly establishing a separate website, landing page, community page, or similar.

Also, each person should probably have a URL.  We should argue how the committee is supposed to broadly represent the whole community.

# Checklist: `x` (done) or `~` (irrelevant)

- [ ] [I am familiar with **ASE's contribution guidelines.**](https://ase-lib.org/development/contribute.html)
- [ ] [**Doc strings** in code changed in this MR are up to date.](https://ase-lib.org/development/python_codingstandard.html#writing-documentation-in-the-code)
- [ ] [**Unit tests** have been added for new or changed code.](https://ase-lib.org/development/tests.html)
- [ ] [**Changes** have been added in `changelog.d` using `scriv`.](https://ase-lib.org/development/writing_changelog.html)
- [ ] [**Issue is resolved** via "closes #XXXX" if applicable.](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/issues/managing_issues.html#closing-issues-automatically)
author: askhl

comments.body: Looking nice! Seems a good balance of information to clutter

comments.author: askhl
comments.body: Thanks @ajjackson!  We might soon have the landing page, but that depends on human time which is unpredictable, like the weather.  So I think I'll just merge (people are done correcting their info, or so it seems) and then we can move the page in the future.
